editorial:
Imagine moving to a creepy mountain town where everyone hates outsiders and you can't even go out in the sun. That is exactly what happens to Santi, a teen who has a scary skin reaction to sunlight. He and his mom move to this quiet Spanish village hoping for a fresh start, but the vibe is wrong from the start. The people there are mean and suspicious, and as soon as violent crimes start happening, everyone points their finger at the weird new kid. You will feel for Santi as he tries to survive both the bullies at school and a killer who seems to be hunting him down.

The acting is solid, and the way the movie builds tension keeps you guessing who the real bad guy is. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the twisty plot makes it worth the ride. If you enjoy mysteries that make you feel uneasy, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: You find out that the town is hiding a dark secret involving a cult and strange rituals. The killer is not Santi, but someone within the community who wants to keep the town's secrets safe. After a lot of tension and blood, the truth comes out about why the villagers act so strange. Santi manages to survive the nightmare, but the movie leaves you feeling that the town will never truly be a safe place.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creepy small-town mysteries and psychological thrillers.
